Tired of looking at a patchy, brown lawn? Whether you've just built a new home on a dirt lot or your existing yard is struggling with bare spots and weeds, trying to grow a lush lawn from seed can feel like a losing battle. Here in Omaha, with our wild weather swings, it’s a slow, frustrating process. That's where we come in. Sod installation is the fastest, most effective way to get the beautiful, green yard you've always wanted.

My name is Bryan, and at A1, we don't just throw down some grass and hope for the best. We deliver an instant lawn. One day you have dirt, the next you have a dense, green carpet that's ready to thrive. It’s a game-changer for your home's curb appeal and your own enjoyment of your outdoor space.

From Bare Dirt to a Green Carpet, Fast

The biggest advantage of sod is the immediate transformation. You don't have to wait weeks for seeds to germinate, fighting off birds and washouts from heavy Nebraska rain. We bring in rolls of healthy, mature turf, and by the time we leave, your yard looks completely finished. This is perfect for new construction homes out in Gretna or Bennington, or for established yards in Papillion that have been damaged by pests, disease, or heavy use.

What Our Sod Installation Service Covers

We handle the entire process from start to finish to ensure your new lawn has the best possible foundation for success. There are no shortcuts here; we do it right so you can enjoy the results for years to come.

Old Lawn & Weed Removal

We start by completely removing the old, dead grass, weeds, and debris to create a clean slate.

Soil Preparation & Grading

Next, we till the soil and grade the area to ensure proper drainage and a smooth, level surface.

Premium Sod Installation

We source high-quality, locally adapted sod and lay it carefully, ensuring tight seams and no gaps.

Rolling & Initial Watering

After laying the sod, we roll it to ensure good root-to-soil contact and give it the first critical watering.

Not Just Laying Grass, We're Building a Healthy Lawn

Anyone can unroll sod, but making it last takes experience. The real secret to a lasting, beautiful lawn is what happens underneath. If your yard has low spots that collect water or slopes that cause runoff, just laying sod over it won't fix the problem. That's why our process often includes yard grading and leveling to correct any underlying drainage or contour issues first. It’s an extra step that makes all the difference.

Once your new sod is installed, proper care is crucial. We don't just leave you hanging; we provide clear instructions on watering and initial maintenance. And when it's ready for its first cut, our lawn care and mowing services can take over to keep it looking its best, ensuring your investment continues to pay off with a gorgeous, healthy lawn.

Frequently Asked Questions

When is the best time to install sod in Omaha?

Spring and fall are ideal for laying sod in our Nebraska climate. The cooler temperatures and consistent rainfall help the new grassroots establish quickly without the stress of summer heat.

How much does sod installation cost in the Omaha area?

The cost depends on the size of your yard and the type of sod you choose. We offer a free, no-obligation estimate so you know the exact price upfront before we begin any work.

Do I need to do anything to prepare my yard for new sod?

Nope, we handle everything. Our service includes removing the old, dead grass, performing any necessary yard grading, and preparing the soil to ensure the new sod takes root properly.

How soon can I walk on my new sod?

You'll want to stay off the new sod for at least two weeks to give the roots time to knit into the soil. We'll give you specific watering and care instructions to make sure your new lawn gets the best possible start.
